SELECT 
    s.id,
    s.nick,
    s.subscription_end,
    s.trial_used,
    s.recurring,
    CASE WHEN s.subscription_end > NOW() THEN true ELSE false END as is_premium,
    COALESCE(g.daily_calories, 2000) as daily_calories,
    COALESCE(g.daily_protein, 120) as daily_protein,
    COALESCE(g.daily_fat, 65) as daily_fat,
    COALESCE(g.daily_carbs, 250) as daily_carbs
FROM subscriptions s
LEFT JOIN user_goals g ON s.id = g.chat_id
WHERE s.id = {{ $json.body.chat_id }}
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO nutrition_log (chat_id, meal_type, description, calories, protein, fat, carbs)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.body.chat_id }},
    '{{ $json.body.meal_type }}',
    '{{ $json.body.description.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $json.body.calories || 0 }},
    {{ $json.body.protein || 0 }},
    {{ $json.body.fat || 0 }},
    {{ $json.body.carbs || 0 }}
)
RETURNING *;

SELECT 
    id, 
    meal_type, 
    description, 
    calories, 
    protein, 
    fat, 
    carbs, 
    image_url,
    created_at
FROM nutrition_log
WHERE chat_id = {{ $json.body.chat_id }}
AND DATE(created_at) = '{{ $json.body.date }}'
ORDER BY created_at ASC;

SELECT 
    DATE(created_at) as date,
    SUM(calories) as total_calories,
    SUM(protein) as total_protein,
    SUM(fat) as total_fat,
    SUM(carbs) as total_carbs,
    COUNT(*) as meals_count
FROM nutrition_log
WHERE chat_id = {{ $json.chat_id }}
AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $json.interval }}'
GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
ORDER BY date DESC;

INSERT INTO user_goals (chat_id, daily_calories, daily_protein, daily_fat, daily_carbs, updated_at)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.body.chat_id }},
    {{ $json.body.calories || 2000 }},
    {{ $json.body.protein || 120 }},
    {{ $json.body.fat || 65 }},
    {{ $json.body.carbs || 250 }},
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE SET
    daily_calories = EXCLUDED.daily_calories,
    daily_protein = EXCLUDED.daily_protein,
    daily_fat = EXCLUDED.daily_fat,
    daily_carbs = EXCLUDED.daily_carbs,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING *;

## BJU Mini App API

Этот workflow обрабатывает API запросы для Mini App трекера питания.

### Эндпоинты:
- **POST /bju/get-user** — получить данные пользователя и его цели
- **POST /bju/log-meal** — добавить приём пищи
- **POST /bju/get-history** — история питания за день
- **POST /bju/get-stats** — статистика за период
- **POST /bju/update-goals** — обновить дневные цели
- **POST /bju/delete-meal** — удалить приём пищи

### База данных:
Используются таблицы:
- `subscriptions` — данные подписок
- `nutrition_log` — лог питания
- `user_goals` — персональные цели
